# WanderNZ

> New Zealand tour discovery platform. 3,112 bookable tours from 366 local operators across both main islands and Stewart Island.

WanderNZ helps travelers find and book authentic New Zealand experiences from local operators. We aggregate tours from 184 towns and areas nationwide, making it easy to discover boat cruises and scenic flights, hiking and biking, jetboating and rafting, wine and food tours, wildlife trips, and Māori cultural experiences. Booking goes direct to the operator.

## Key Pages

- [Homepage](https://wandernewzealand.com/): Search and browse New Zealand tours
- [All Tours](https://wandernewzealand.com/tours.html): Complete tour directory with filters
- [Islands Guide](https://wandernewzealand.com/islands.html): North Island, South Island and Stewart Island — what each is for and where to base
- [Auckland Guide](https://wandernewzealand.com/auckland.html): Auckland tours, Hauraki Gulf islands and Waiheke wine
- [Queenstown Guide](https://wandernewzealand.com/queenstown.html): Queenstown tours, Lake Wakatipu, bungy and jetboat operators
- [Rotorua Guide](https://wandernewzealand.com/rotorua.html): Rotorua tours, geothermal parks and Māori cultural experiences
- [Milford Sound Guide](https://wandernewzealand.com/milford-sound.html): Milford Sound tours and cruises with live prices, and when Doubtful Sound is the better pick

## Regional Guides (Nov–Mar season)

- [Nelson & Abel Tasman](https://wandernewzealand.com/nelson-abel-tasman.html): Abel Tasman sea kayaking, water taxis, Nelson wine and bike trails
- [Christchurch & Akaroa](https://wandernewzealand.com/christchurch.html): Akaroa dolphins, Pōhatu penguins, punting, Arthur's Pass
- [Dunedin & Otago Peninsula](https://wandernewzealand.com/dunedin.html): Royal albatross, yellow-eyed penguins, Otago Peninsula wildlife cruises, Larnach Castle
- [Wellington](https://wandernewzealand.com/wellington.html): Zealandia, harbour cruises, Lord of the Rings locations, food and beer walks
- [Wānaka & Cardrona](https://wandernewzealand.com/wanaka.html): Skydiving, Mount Aspiring heli-hikes, lake cruises, Cardrona
- [Tauranga & Mount Maunganui](https://wandernewzealand.com/tauranga-mount-maunganui.html): Dolphin cruises, surf lessons, glow-worm kayaking, Hobbiton day trips
- [Taupō](https://wandernewzealand.com/taupo.html): Huka Falls jet, Māori rock carvings by boat and kayak, skydiving, Tongariro Crossing
- [Fiordland & Te Anau](https://wandernewzealand.com/fiordland-te-anau.html): Milford and Doubtful Sound from Te Anau, glowworm caves, heli-flights, Great Walks
- [Kaikōura](https://wandernewzealand.com/kaikoura.html): Sperm whale watching, dusky dolphin swims, seal kayaking
- [Bay of Islands](https://wandernewzealand.com/bay-of-islands.html): Hole in the Rock cruises, dolphins, Waitangi, Haruru Falls kayaking, Cape Reinga
- [Doubtful Sound cruises](https://wandernewzealand.com/doubtful-sound-cruises.html): Day and overnight Doubtful Sound cruises from Manapouri, Te Anau and Queenstown
- [Fiordland cruises](https://wandernewzealand.com/fiordland-cruises.html): Every Milford and Doubtful Sound cruise with prices: day, overnight, coach and fly packages
- [Jet ski hire Auckland](https://wandernewzealand.com/auckland-jet-ski-hire.html): Hourly jet ski hire and tours on the Hauraki Gulf; no licence needed

## Activity Guides

- [Kayaking](https://wandernewzealand.com/kayak.html): Sea, river and lake paddling; Abel Tasman National Park, Milford and Doubtful Sound, Bay of Islands, Lake Wakatipu, Whanganui River
- [Fishing](https://wandernewzealand.com/fishing.html): Inshore, offshore and freshwater charters; Bay of Islands, Lake Taupō, Tongariro River, Marlborough Sounds, Stewart Island, Kaikōura
- [Whale Watching](https://wandernewzealand.com/whale-watching.html): Boat and coastal spotting; Kaikōura, Bay of Islands, Hauraki Gulf, Akaroa Harbour, Cook Strait
- [Waterfalls](https://wandernewzealand.com/waterfalls.html): Hike-in, roadside and aerial views; Sutherland Falls, Huka Falls, Wairere Falls, McLean Falls, Bridal Veil Falls, Stirling Falls
- [Snorkeling](https://wandernewzealand.com/snorkeling.html): Reef, boat and wildlife snorkel; Goat Island and Tāwharanui marine reserves, Poor Knights Islands, Marlborough Sounds
- [Jet Skis](https://wandernewzealand.com/jet-ski.html): Guided rides and rentals; Lake Wakatipu, Lake Taupō, Lake Rotoiti, Lake Wanaka, Bay of Islands, Tauranga Harbour
- [Ziplines](https://wandernewzealand.com/zipline.html): Canopy and high-line courses; Rotorua Canopy Tours, Christchurch Adventure Park, Waiheke Island, Velocity Valley
- [Shark Diving](https://wandernewzealand.com/shark-diving.html): Cage and free-swim encounters; Stewart Island out of Bluff, Poor Knights Islands, Three Kings Islands

## Quick Facts

- 3,112 bookable tours from 366 local operators
- 184 towns and areas covered; the largest are Queenstown (378 tours), Auckland (309), Nelson (155), Dunedin (128), Wellington (96), Christchurch (96), Rotorua (83) and Tauranga (68)
- Tours include: guided and private tours, boat tours and cruises, biking and bike rentals, sightseeing and walking tours, horse riding, hiking, wine and winery tours, fishing, rafting, surfing, food tours, farm visits, scuba, kayaking and canoeing, helicopter and scenic flights, and wildlife trips
- Booking links go directly to tour operators via FareHarbor
- Most prices are listed in NZD; the median listed price is about NZD 210, ranging from under NZD 100 for short activities to several thousand for private charters and multi-day trips

## Things to do by region (2026)

- [14 Best Things to Do in Christchurch, New Zealand](https://wandernewzealand.com/blog/things-to-do-christchurch.html): The best things to do in Christchurch and Banks Peninsula — the rebuilt city centre, Akaroa's dolphins and penguins, the gondola, punting on the Avon and day trips into the Alps.
- [14 Best Things to Do in Nelson & Abel Tasman, New Zealand](https://wandernewzealand.com/blog/things-to-do-nelson-abel-tasman.html): The best things to do in Nelson and Abel Tasman National Park — kayaking the golden-sand coast, the Coast Track, water taxis, mountain biking, the Saturday market and Golden Bay day trips.
- [14 Best Things to Do in Dunedin, New Zealand](https://wandernewzealand.com/blog/things-to-do-dunedin.html): The best things to do in Dunedin — albatross and penguins on the Otago Peninsula, Larnach Castle, the Taieri Gorge railway, Speight's, the world's steepest street and the Moeraki Boulders.
- [13 Best Things to Do in Wānaka, New Zealand](https://wandernewzealand.com/blog/things-to-do-wanaka.html): The best things to do in Wānaka — Roys Peak, the Wānaka Tree, Rob Roy Glacier, lake cruises to Mou Waho, jet boating, the lavender farm, Blue Pools and Cardrona.
- [14 Best Things to Do in Taupō, New Zealand](https://wandernewzealand.com/blog/things-to-do-taupo.html): The best things to do in Taupō — Huka Falls, the Māori rock carvings by boat or kayak, the Tongariro Alpine Crossing, hot springs, floatplane flights, skydiving and Orakei Korako.
- [13 Best Things to Do in Kaikōura, New Zealand](https://wandernewzealand.com/blog/things-to-do-kaikoura.html): The best things to do in Kaikōura — whale watching by boat and plane, swimming with dusky dolphins, seal kayaking, the Peninsula Walkway, crayfish, fishing charters and the Mount Fyffe track.
- [13 Best Things to Do in Bay of Islands, New Zealand](https://wandernewzealand.com/blog/things-to-do-bay-of-islands.html): The best things to do in the Bay of Islands — Hole in the Rock cruises, Waitangi Treaty Grounds, Russell, dolphin cruises, kayaking to Haruru Falls, Kawiti glowworm caves and Cape Reinga day trips.
- [13 Best Things to Do in Te Anau & Fiordland, New Zealand](https://wandernewzealand.com/blog/things-to-do-te-anau-fiordland.html): The best things to do in Te Anau and Fiordland — Milford Sound and Doubtful Sound cruises, the Te Anau glowworm caves, the Kepler and Routeburn day walks, the Milford Road stops and Lake Manapouri.
